COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
 C-482 No. 598 of 2021 
Hon’ble N.S. Dhanik, J .
Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, learned 
counsel for the applicant. 
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, learned Brief 
Holder for the State. 
Learned counsel for the applicant 
would submit that from the bare perusal 
of the complaint filed against the 
applicant, prima facie, nothing has been 
disclosed by the second respondent 
herein and there are no particulars 
whatsoever against the applicant herein 
in the complaint as to how he owned Rs. 
2,00,000/- to the second respondent. It 
is also submitted that a Full Bench of the 
Kerala High Court has also held in 
Lakshmanan V/s Sivarana Krishnan, 
that unless the effected party filed a 
written complaint after satisfying all 
statutory conditions, an offence 
committed cannot be taken cognizance. 
Issue notice to the second 
respondent. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
List this case after service report is 
received. 
Meanwhile, summoning order 
issued against the applicant shall be kept 
in abeyance. 
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.) 
 21.06.2021
SB
